message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I’ll admit, my first instinct was to scramble for the flashlights. But then my kids started pulling out their favorite glow sticks and turning it into a mini dance party in the living room! 🌟 It reminded me that even in the dark, we can find a way to have fun. Now I keep a stash of glow sticks handy for just such occasions, and it helps keep the mood light. What are your go-to tricks for making power outages a little brighter?
